responsibility: Defines NVPTX inline-assembly register classes by PTX register width and their supported operand types, while intentionally exposing no fixed registers because PTX registers are declared within the assembly itself.
same_name_distinction: This `nvptx.rs` is the inline-assembly target description for NVPTX: it defines asm register classes and operand-type support, and notes that PTX has no predefined fixed registers. Unlike the other `nvptx.rs`, it does not classify function arguments or returns for the ABI.
